## Description

Summary of changes, motivation, and context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update / Refactor
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)

## Testing Performed

- [ ] Automated unit tests pass: `python3 -m unittest -v test_migrate.py`
- [ ] Verified via `--dry-run`
- [ ] End-to-end / live cluster verification (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes adhere to repository conventions and coding style
- [ ] New/updated flags and behaviors are documented in `README.md`
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials committed
